query: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.address, d.port, d.description, d.machine_id, (SELECT h.id FROM repo_hosts h WHERE h.machine_id = d.machine_id) AS "repo_host_id?", m.intermittent, m.last_checked_at, m.last_check_reachable, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.schedule_id) FROM (SELECT sd.schedule_id FROM schedule_dependencies sd WHERE sd.dependency_host_id = d.id UNION SELECT st.schedule_id FROM agent_default_dependencies ad JOIN schedule_targets st ON st.agent_id = ad.agent_id WHERE ad.dependency_host_id = d.id UNION SELECT sr.schedule_id FROM repo_host_dependencies rd JOIN repos r ON r.repo_host_id = rd.repo_host_id JOIN schedule_repos sr ON sr.repo_id = r.id WHERE rd.dependency_host_id = d.id) u) AS "schedule_count!", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_default_dependencies ad WHERE ad.dependency_host_id = d.id) AS "agent_default_count!", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dependency_catch_ups c WHERE c.dependency_host_id = d.id) AS "waiting_count!" FROM dependency_hosts d JOIN machines m ON m.id = d.machine_id WHERE ($1::bigint IS NULL OR d.id = $1) ORDER BY d.name
